18 Prague hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Prices on this page are per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees; the study's count below uses the before-tax prices of its CSV. The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price).

One snapshot on September 28, 2026 for Nov 2 to Nov 4, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Prague hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 28, 2026 snapshot, at 15 of the 18 Prague hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 8, Priceline at 2, Traveluro at 2, Agoda at 1, Radissonhotels.com at 1 and the hotel's own site at 1. These are the Prague rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

Taxes and fees at Prague hotels

At the 15 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 16% ($17 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 14% at Hotel NH Collection Prague Carlo IV to 18% at Hotel Don Giovanni Prague. At 3 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
